description: This source file defines a `CameraController` actor responsible for handling camera and microphone access, capturing photos and videos, listing devices, and managing related errors in an iOS app. It includes nested types for device info, errors, and delegates for photo and video capture, utilizing AVFoundation for media processing.

classes.name: CameraDeviceInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a camera device, including id, name, position, and device type.

classes.name: CameraError
classes.description: Defines possible errors related to camera operations, such as hardware unavailability or permission issues, with localized descriptions.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Handles photo capture callbacks, providing photo data or errors asynchronously.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Handles video recording callbacks, providing recorded file URL or errors asynchronously.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo based on provided parameters and returns format, base64 data, width, and height.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip based on provided parameters and returns format, base64 data, duration, and audio presence.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks for camera or microphone permission, throws if access is denied.

methods.name: pickCamera
methods.description: Selects a camera device based on facing direction and device ID.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps setup errors during movie session configuration to CameraError.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Provides a label for a given camera position.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamp video clip duration between 250ms and 60000ms.

methods.name: exportToMP4
methods.description: Exports a video from a source URL to MP4 format asynchronously.

methods.name: sleepDelayMs
methods.description: Asynchronously sleeps for the specified delay in milliseconds.
